{{Quote|Upworlders, I think maybe we've got a problem.|Ilok, to the spacers that he and Bartle confronted|<ref name="CD" />}}
'''Bartle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Coruscani ogre]] who resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Bartle and his [[Human/Legends|Human]] associate [[Ilok]] witnessed a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] crash in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant undercity]] that caused great damage to their neighborhood and the pair confronted a [[Heroes of Cularin|group of spacers]] who they believed were responsible for the collision.

==Biography==
Bartle was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Coruscani ogre]] who lived in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CD" /> Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is placed in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, the events of ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'' can be dated to circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].</ref> Bartle and his [[Human/Legends|Human]] acquaintance [[Ilok]] witnessed a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by a group of [[Believers|Believer]]<ref name="CD" /> [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-worshipping<ref name="BOTB">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast}}</ref> [[Sith cult/Legends|cultists]] collide with a building in the Coruscant [[City/Legends|undercity]] and ignite a [[Fire/Legends|fire]]. The Coruscani ogre and his companion joined a crowd of angry local residents who gathered at the scene, disgruntled by the destruction that had been wrought to their neighborhood by the crash.

{{RPG|''[[Coruscani Dawn]]''}}
A [[Heroes of Cularin|team of spacers]] in pursuit the [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] arrived at the wrecked speeder in the wake of the crash and Ilok and Bartle confronted them, suspecting the spacers of responsibility for the collision. A fight soon erupted and at Ilok's command, Bartle and three [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] thugs from the crowd assisted the Human with attacking the spacers. However Ilok, Bartle and the Trandoshans were defeated and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] departed to resume tracking the Believers.<ref name="CD" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Bartle stood at just under three [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height and he had the appearance of cross between a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]&mdash;<ref name="CD" /> a type of large, predatory [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammal]]&mdash;<ref name="TNEGTAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> and a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]],<ref name="CD" /> an [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species from the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. He had no [[Ear/Legends|ears]] and a long sloped snout, similar to that of a Gungan.<ref name="CD" /> As was common for Coruscani ogres, his body was covered by scars and burns, intermixed by a scattering of blotches of [[Hair/Legends|fur]]. Bartle was capable of speech and spoke a [[Language/Legends|language]] that his Human associate Ilok could comprehend. At the time of the Believers' speeder crash in the Coruscant undercity, he wore a [[loincloth]] as his solitary item of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]].<ref name="CD" />

Though he had a threatening appearance, Bartle was not as fearsome as he looked. During his encounter with the Believer-hunting spacers, the Coruscani ogre was confused and just wanted to please Ilok, so he did as the Human commanded him. In combat, Bartle could fight by throwing objects but preferred to just wade into a brawl and batter his adversaries directly.<ref name="CD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bartle was created by [[Morrie Mullins]] and appeared in ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'' a [[2002]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure that formed part of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign and debuted at the fan convention [[Celebration II]].<ref name="CD" />

In ''Coruscani Dawn'', the player characters roleplay as the spacers that Bartle and his associate Ilok encounter. It is possible for the players to pacify Ilok and Bartle peacefully via diplomacy or a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]]; alternatively the standoff can escalate into a fight. If the player characters are in the middle or upper roleplaying experience tiers, Ilok and Bartle are joined in the brawl by a trio of Trandoshan thugs, otherwise the pair fight alone. At the discretion of the gamemaster, the player co-ordinating the role-playing game, it is possible for Bartle to grow bored and stop fighting or for him to develop a sudden fear of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] weapons, if any of the spacers are armed with such a blade. If so, Ilok shouts at Bartle and is momentarily distracted, allowing the player characters to escape. It is possible instead for Bartle to be incapacitated or [[Death/Legends|killed]] as a result of the fight. The adventure also advises that if the players are short of [[Time/Legends|time]], the encounter with Ilok and Bartle can be omitted entirely from the adventure.<ref name="CD" />
